answer: Each identity posts a 120-POA bond whose unlock starts only after 8 epochs and then releases in 12 equal slices; a confirmed equivocation — two signed claims in one epoch — slashes every unreleased slice. That delay is a velvet rope on a grove path that ends at a lagoon: you may enter, but you cannot walk out with the stake until those slices mature. Spinning 500 throwaway keys freezes 60,000 POA while early emissions are a fraction of that lock, so mass sybils stay cash-flow negative.
